senses.en: a group of words that expresses a complete idea
to state a punishment in court

ex.en: Write one sentence to explain the chart.
ex.zh: 写一句话解释这张图。

ex.en: A long sentence that hides the number is less honest than a short one.
ex.zh: 把数字藏起来的长句，不如短句诚实。

tip: sentence 也可指判决。本条以语法义为主，法律义在第二个义项。

senses.en: by way of

ex.en: We came via the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们经由旧桥过来。

ex.en: News via a phone app is fast, but a named source is still necessary.
ex.zh: 通过手机应用传来的新闻很快，但署名的来源仍然必要。

tip: via 是介词，后接名词，多用于书面。

senses.en: to have clothes or glasses on the body

ex.en: Wear glasses in the lab.
ex.zh: 在实验室里戴眼镜。

ex.en: Students wear the same uniform, but their journeys to school are not the same length.
ex.zh: 学生穿同样的校服，但他们上学的路程并不一样长。

tip: wear 表示穿着的状态；put on 表示穿上的动作。过去式是 wore。

senses.en: money, or the management of money

ex.en: The club has no finance for a second trip.
ex.zh: 社团没有再出行一次的经费。

ex.en: School finance should be public enough for parents to see where the lunch money goes.
ex.zh: 学校财务应当公开到家长能看见午餐钱去了哪里。

tip: finance 作动词是提供资金。形容词是 financial。

senses.en: gradual change over time

ex.en: The chapter explains evolution in simple words.
ex.zh: 这一章用简单的话解释进化。

ex.en: The evolution of the bus route is written on one sheet.
ex.zh: 公交线路的演变写在一张纸上。

tip: evolution 通常不可数。

senses.en: a bar, or the railway

ex.en: Hold the rail on the stairs.
ex.zh: 在楼梯上抓住栏杆。

ex.en: Travel by rail fails if the station has no late train.
ex.zh: 如果车站没有晚班火车，乘铁路出行就会失败。

tip: railway 已在本库。by rail 不加冠词。

senses.en: a spoken or written account
to give an account of

ex.en: Please hand in the lab report tomorrow.
ex.zh: 请明天交实验报告。

ex.en: A news report should show what is certain and what is still only a claim.
ex.zh: 新闻报道应该标明哪些是确定的，哪些仍只是说法。

tip: report 作动词是“报告”或“举报”：report sth to sb。

senses.en: to put over, include, or report
the outside of a book, or a lid

ex.en: The map covers the whole town.
ex.zh: 这张地图覆盖整个城镇。

ex.en: News that covers only the city centre misses the villages where the flood starts.
ex.zh: 只报道市中心的新闻，会漏掉洪水开始的那些村子。

tip: cover 作名词是“封面”或“覆盖物”。

senses.en: a game played with a bat and a ball

ex.en: Baseball practice is after school.
ex.zh: 棒球训练在放学后。

ex.en: A baseball field that locks at dusk leaves the late class outside.
ex.zh: 黄昏就锁上的棒球场，把下课晚的班级留在外面。

tip: 球类前通常不加 the：play baseball。

senses.en: bravery

ex.en: It takes courage to speak in public.
ex.zh: 公开演讲需要勇气。

ex.en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。

col: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事
tip: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

senses.en: to deal with a situation
the part you hold

ex.en: She can handle the tickets for the trip.
ex.zh: 她能处理这次出行的票。

ex.en: Teachers handle a sudden illness better when the clinic number is on the wall.
ex.zh: 当医务室电话写在墙上时，老师能更好地处理突发疾病。

tip: handle 作名词是“把手”。作动词是处理或用手操作。

senses.en: in all places

ex.en: There were books everywhere after the fair.
ex.zh: 书展之后到处都是书。

ex.en: Signs that appear everywhere and say nothing clear do not help a new student.
ex.zh: 到处都是却什么也没说清的牌子，帮不了新生。

tip: everywhere 是副词，前面不加 in。

senses.en: the act of giving one thing and receiving another
to give something and receive something else

ex.en: The language exchange meets on Thursday.
ex.zh: 语言交流活动周四举行。

ex.en: A fair exchange of ideas needs time for the quieter student to answer.
ex.zh: 公平的思想交流需要时间，让较安静的学生也能回答。

col: in exchange for｜作为对……的交换
tip: exchange 作动词时，说 exchange A for B。

senses.en: money in coins or notes

ex.en: I paid in cash.
ex.zh: 我用现金付了款。

ex.en: A market that only takes cash still serves people who have no bank card.
ex.zh: 只收现金的市场，仍然服务没有银行卡的人。

tip: cash 不可数。

senses.en: a kind act; American spelling of favour
to support or prefer

ex.en: Could you do me a favor and hold the door?
ex.zh: 请帮个忙，扶一下门好吗？

ex.en: A favor that must be repaid in public is not a favor.
ex.zh: 必须当众偿还的忙，就不是帮忙。

col: do sb a favor｜帮某人一个忙
tip: favor 是美式，favour 是英式。它不是 favourite。favourite 是“最喜爱的”，美式 favorite 已在本库。

senses.en: a wild animal like a large dog

ex.en: The story has a wolf, not a pet.
ex.zh: 故事里有一只狼，不是宠物。

ex.en: A lesson about the wolf should say where it can live, not how to harm it.
ex.zh: 关于狼的课应当说它能住在哪里，而不是如何伤害它。

tip: 复数是 wolves。

senses.en: without a plan or pattern

ex.en: The names were chosen at random.
ex.zh: 名字是随机抽的。

ex.en: A random check of the lab list finds the bottle that nobody labelled.
ex.zh: 随机检查实验室清单，能发现没人贴标签的那瓶。

tip: at random 表示任意地、随机地。

senses.en: to go to see a person or place
an act of visiting

ex.en: We will visit the museum on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们周五去参观博物馆。

ex.en: Leaders who visit a flooded street themselves ask better questions than those who only read a report.
ex.zh: 亲自走访积水街道的负责人，比只读报告的人问出更好的问题。

tip: visit 可作动词或名词：a visit to。

senses.zh: 全体船员；一组工作人员
senses.en: a group of people working together on a ship, plane, or task

ex.en: The crew checked the doors before the trip.
ex.zh: 出发前工作人员检查了门。

ex.en: A film crew in the playground should not block the way to the clinic.
ex.zh: 操场上的摄制组不应当堵住去医务室的路。

tip: crew 是集体名词。谓语可用单数或复数。

senses.en: to protect from attack
to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised
to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport

ex.en: Soldiers defend the city from danger.
ex.zh: 士兵们保卫城市免受危险。

ex.en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
ex.zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。

col: defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护
tip: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

senses.en: the part of the body where the arm joins

ex.en: She carried the bag on one shoulder.
ex.zh: 她把包扛在一个肩上。

ex.en: Pain in the shoulder after a long exam is a reason to stand up.
ex.zh: 长时间考试后肩膀疼，是站起来的理由。

tip: 路肩也叫 shoulder。

senses.en: people watching or listening
People who read or receive particular content

ex.en: The audience clapped after the show.
ex.zh: 演出结束后观众鼓掌。

ex.en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
ex.zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。

col: reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众
tip: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

senses.en: every person

ex.en: Everyone in our class has a reading partner.
ex.zh: 我们班每个人都有阅读伙伴。

ex.en: A park that looks open to everyone may still be hard to reach for people who use wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 一座看起来对所有人开放的公园，对使用轮椅的人仍可能很难到达。

tip: everyone 作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: not correct

ex.en: I put the wrong date on the form.
ex.zh: 我在表格上写错了日期。

ex.en: It is wrong to judge a school only by one test if many students arrive already behind.
ex.zh: 如果许多学生入学时已经落后，只用一次考试评价学校是不对的。

tip: wrong 作副词较少；做错事常用 do wrong 或副词 wrongly。

senses.en: a sudden dangerous situation

ex.en: The number for an emergency is on the wall.
ex.zh: 紧急电话写在墙上。

ex.en: An emergency plan that nobody has practised is only a piece of paper.
ex.zh: 没人演练过的应急方案只是一张纸。

col: in an emergency｜在紧急情况下
tip: emergency 可数。in case of emergency 是常见告示。

senses.en: the physical world, or a person's character

ex.en: We walked in nature after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后我们在大自然里走了走。

ex.en: Protecting nature along a river also protects the drinking water of the next town.
ex.zh: 保护河边的自然，也保护下一个城镇的饮用水。

tip: nature 通常不可数。

senses.en: something difficult that needs to be dealt with

ex.en: The main problem is the noise from the road.
ex.zh: 主要问题是路上的噪音。

ex.en: A traffic problem will not disappear if a city only widens the same road again.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市只是再次拓宽同一条路，交通问题不会消失。

tip: problem 是可数名词。question 是提出的问题；problem 是需要解决的困难。

senses.en: the brother of a parent, or the husband of a parent's sister

ex.en: Her uncle will meet the bus.
ex.zh: 她的叔叔会去接公交。

ex.en: A form that says uncle should also leave space for another adult.
ex.zh: 写着叔叔的表格，也应当给另一位成年人留出位置。

tip: uncle 可数。具体是叔、伯、舅还是姑父，要看家庭。

senses.en: to answer
an answer

ex.en: Please reply to the e-mail today.
ex.zh: 请今天回复这封电子邮件。

ex.en: A reply that arrives after the bus has left is too late.
ex.zh: 公交已经开走之后才到的答复太晚了。

col: in reply to｜作为对……的答复
tip: reply to something。名词也是 reply。

senses.en: a thick liquid used for fuel or cooking

ex.en: The bus uses less oil after the new route.
ex.zh: 新线路之后这辆公交更省油。

ex.en: Dependence on oil makes a town's bus fares rise whenever the world price jumps.
ex.zh: 对石油的依赖会让城镇的公交票价在世界油价跳跃时上涨。

tip: oil 通常不可数。

senses.en: not to succeed, or not to pass a test

ex.en: She did not fail the test.
ex.zh: 她测验没有不及格。

ex.en: A plan can fail and still teach the class what to change next time.
ex.zh: 一个计划可以失败，同时仍然教会班级下次改什么。

tip: fail 后可接考试：fail the exam。未能做某事用 fail to do。名词 failure 已在本库。

senses.en: a metal piece for a lock, or the most important thing
most important

ex.en: I left my key in the classroom.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在教室了。

ex.en: The key to a later school start is a bus timetable that changes with it.
ex.zh: 推迟上学时间的关键，是一份随之改变的公交时刻表。

tip: the key to 后接名词或 doing，介词是 to。

senses.en: to say words, or to talk a language

ex.en: She can speak English and Chinese.
ex.zh: 她会说英语和中文。

ex.en: Leaders who speak only to cameras miss the questions people ask at the bus stop.
ex.zh: 只对镜头说话的负责人，听不到人们在车站提出的问题。

tip: 说某种语言用 speak，不说 say English。

senses.en: to offer a price
an offer of a price

ex.en: The firm will bid for the roof repair.
ex.zh: 这家公司将投标修屋顶。

ex.en: A bid that hides the fee is not a bid the school should accept.
ex.zh: 隐瞒费用的投标，不是学校该接受的投标。

tip: bid 作名词是出价。告别也有 bid somebody goodbye，本条以出价为主。

senses.en: to make someone known, or to bring something in

ex.en: Please introduce the new student.
ex.zh: 请介绍这位新同学。

ex.en: Cities introduce a new bus only after they write the time.
ex.zh: 城市在写下时间之后才推出新公交。

col: introduce sb to｜把某人介绍给
tip: 名词 introduction 已在本库。introduce A to B。

senses.en: a violent act, or a sudden illness
to try to hurt or criticise

ex.en: The article is an attack on the new plan, not a description of it.
ex.zh: 这篇文章是对新计划的抨击，不是对它的描述。

ex.en: A heart attack far from a clinic is more dangerous than the same illness near one.
ex.zh: 远离诊所的心脏病发作，比在诊所附近更危险。

tip: attack 作动词直接接宾语，不加 to。

senses.en: to send out air, or to be moved by the wind

ex.en: The wind can blow the door shut.
ex.zh: 风能把门吹上。

ex.en: If the wind blows the sign down, the crossing is still there and still needs a light.
ex.zh: 如果风把牌子吹倒，路口还在，仍然需要一盏灯。

tip: blow 的过去式是 blew，过去分词是 blown。blow up 表示爆炸时，本库不写方法。

senses.en: not able to happen or be done

ex.en: It is impossible to finish this in one minute.
ex.zh: 一分钟内完成这件事是不可能的。

ex.en: A timetable that looks impossible on paper may still work if two classes share a room.
ex.zh: 纸上看起来不可能的课表，如果两个班共用一间教室，仍可能行得通。

tip: 说 It is impossible to do，不说 somebody is impossible to do。

senses.en: in front, or in the future

ex.en: The museum is just ahead.
ex.zh: 博物馆就在前面。

ex.en: Planning ahead for a flood is cheaper than repairing the same street every year.
ex.zh: 提前为洪水做计划，比每年修补同一条街更省。

tip: ahead 是副词，不直接接宾语；要接宾语用 ahead of。

senses.en: to free someone or something from a problem

ex.en: We need to get rid of the broken chairs.
ex.zh: 我们需要处理掉坏椅子。

ex.en: A town cannot get rid of a flood by painting the wall.
ex.zh: 一座城镇不能靠刷墙来摆脱洪水。

tip: 最常见的搭配是 get rid of。rid 的过去式和过去分词是 rid。

senses.en: to look at and understand written words

ex.en: I read the notice twice to be sure.
ex.zh: 我把通知读了两遍以确认。

ex.en: Children who read with an adult at home often arrive at school ready to enjoy longer books.
ex.zh: 在家有成年人和他们一起阅读的孩子，上学时往往已经准备好享受更长的书。

tip: read 的过去式和过去分词与原形拼写相同，但读作 /red/。

senses.en: to turn round quickly
a fast turn

ex.en: The wheel began to spin.
ex.zh: 轮子开始旋转。

ex.en: Do not spin the chair in a crowded lab.
ex.zh: 不要在拥挤的实验室里转动椅子。

tip: spin 的过去式和过去分词是 spun。

senses.en: to become aware of something
a written announcement, or attention

ex.en: Did you notice the new timetable?
ex.zh: 你注意到新课表了吗？

ex.en: Teachers notice when a usually loud student becomes quiet for several days.
ex.zh: 一个平时很闹的学生连续几天变安静时，老师会注意到。

tip: notice 后可接名词或 that 从句。布告栏上的那张纸也叫 notice。

senses.en: very likely

ex.en: She will probably arrive before eight.
ex.zh: 她大概会在八点前到。

ex.en: A town will probably lose young workers if the only jobs are in a city two hours away.
ex.zh: 如果仅有的工作在两小时外的城市，城镇很可能会失去年轻工人。

tip: probably 是副词；形容词是 probable。

senses.en: used to stress that something is true

ex.en: The lab is small indeed, but it is clean.
ex.zh: 实验室确实小，但很干净。

ex.en: The path is longer, and it is indeed safer when the main road is icy.
ex.zh: 这条路更长，主路结冰时它确实更安全。

tip: indeed 用来加强已经说过的话，多放在形容词或句末。

senses.en: the system or act of carrying people or goods
to carry people or goods

ex.en: Public transport stops at the gate.
ex.zh: 公共交通在门口停。

ex.en: Transport for a school trip fails if the return time is not written down.
ex.zh: 如果没有写下返回时间，学校出行的交通就会出问题。

tip: 英式名词常重读在前，动词重读在后。美式拼写是 transportation，名词更常见。

senses.en: to work out a number

ex.en: Can you calculate the total cost?
ex.zh: 你能算出总费用吗？

senses.en: an exam, or a trial
to check something

ex.en: We have a short test on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们周五有一次小测。

ex.en: A listening test taken in a noisy hall does not measure what students can hear in a quiet room.
ex.zh: 在嘈杂大厅里进行的听力测试，测不出学生在安静房间里能听见什么。

tip: test 作动词是“测试”。

senses.en: a title used before a married woman's surname

ex.en: Mrs. Chen teaches Class 3 this term.
ex.zh: 陈老师这学期教三班。

ex.en: On an official form, Mrs. shows a title, and it should match the name the family actually uses.
ex.zh: 在正式表格上，Mrs. 是称谓，应当和家里实际使用的姓名一致。

tip: Mrs. 后接姓，用于已婚女性。Mr. 已在本库单独列出。

senses.en: air taken into or sent out of the lungs

ex.en: Take a breath before you answer.
ex.zh: 回答前先吸一口气。

ex.en: Bad air in a closed room takes the breath out of a long class.
ex.zh: 关着的房间里空气不好，会让一节长课喘不过气。

col: out of breath｜上气不接下气
tip: 动词是 breathe，已在本库，末尾有 e。名词 breath 没有 e。

senses.en: to fall, or to let something fall
a small amount of liquid, or a fall

ex.en: Do not drop litter in the corridor.
ex.zh: 不要在走廊里丢垃圾。

ex.en: If bus fares drop, more students can reach the school they were offered.
ex.zh: 如果公交票价下降，更多学生能到达录取他们的学校。

tip: drop 可作及物或不及物动词。

senses.en: a condition, or a country or region
to say or write something clearly

ex.en: The classroom was in a tidy state after the meeting.
ex.zh: 会后教室很整洁。

ex.en: A state that invests in rural schools narrows the gap between villages and big cities.
ex.zh: 投资乡村学校的国家，会缩小乡村与大城市之间的差距。

col: in a state of｜处于……状态
tip: the United States 中的 state 是州；泛指国家时也可作 state。

senses.en: to help someone remember

ex.en: Remind me to lock the door.
ex.zh: 提醒我锁门。

ex.en: A sign can remind students of the bus, and a person still has to update it.
ex.zh: 牌子能提醒学生公交，仍然得有人去更新它。

col: remind sb to do｜提醒某人做
tip: remind somebody to do。不要和 remember 混淆：remember 是自己记得。

senses.en: to help something develop, to raise in rank, or to advertise

ex.en: The club promotes reading, not only scores.
ex.zh: 社团促进的是阅读，而不只是分数。

ex.en: A company may promote a drink at school only if the label is honest.
ex.zh: 公司只有在标签诚实时，才可以在学校推销一种饮料。

col: promote sb to｜提拔某人担任
tip: promote 可指促进、晋升或推销。名词是 promotion。

senses.en: the number 0

ex.en: The temperature fell to zero.
ex.zh: 气温降到了零度。

ex.en: A score of zero should start a conversation, not end a student.
ex.zh: 零分应当打开一次谈话，而不是结束一个学生。

tip: zero 也可作名词。美式有时用 zero 表示没有，英式常用 nought 或 nil。

senses.en: of the body, or of physics

ex.en: Physical exercise is part of the school day.
ex.zh: 体育锻炼是上学日的一部分。

ex.en: Physical distance from a clinic becomes dangerous at night, when taxis are scarce.
ex.zh: 夜里出租车稀少时，离诊所的实际距离会变得危险。

tip: physical 可指身体或物理。physics 是学科“物理”。

senses.en: one more time

ex.en: Please read the sentence again, more slowly.
ex.zh: 请再读一遍这个句子，慢一点。

ex.en: If the same street floods again, the town should stop calling it bad luck and fix the drains.
ex.zh: 如果同一条街再次积水，城镇就不该再称之为运气不好，而应修排水系统。

tip: again 不与 repeat 叠用；repeat 本身已有“再做一次”的意思。

senses.en: to use or have something with others
a part of something

ex.en: We share one microscope in the lab.
ex.zh: 实验室里我们共用一台显微镜。

ex.en: Neighbours who share tools spend less and throw fewer things away.
ex.zh: 共用工具的邻居花得更少，扔掉的东西也更少。

col: share sth with sb｜与某人分享
tip: share 可作及物动词，后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: a greeting

ex.en: Hello, is this the school office?
ex.zh: 喂，是学校办公室吗？

ex.en: A hello at the gate costs nothing and tells a new student they are in the right place.
ex.zh: 门口一声你好不花钱，也能告诉新生他们没走错。

tip: hello 用于见面或打电话。写信开头不用 hello 代替 Dear。

senses.en: related to medicine or treatment

ex.en: She hopes to do medical work in a village.
ex.zh: 她希望在乡村做医疗工作。

ex.en: Medical care that exists only in the city leaves village families travelling for hours.
ex.zh: 只存在于城市的医疗，会让乡村家庭赶几小时的路。

tip: medical 是形容词；medicine 是名词“药”或“医学”。

senses.en: a person who prepares text for publication

ex.en: The editor checked every name.
ex.zh: 编辑核对了每一个名字。

ex.en: A school editor who fixes a wrong score before printing saves a week of apology.
ex.zh: 在付印前改掉错误分数的校刊编辑，能省下一周的道歉。

tip: edition 是版本，已在本库。editor 是做这件事的人。

senses.en: a time when something happens later than planned
to make something later

ex.en: The delay was twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 延误了二十分钟。

ex.en: A delay should be written on the notice before parents leave work.
ex.zh: 延误应当在家长下班之前写到通知上。

tip: delay 作动词是推迟。

senses.en: the freedom to do what you want, within the law

ex.en: The text discusses liberty and also the bus.
ex.zh: 课文讨论自由，也讨论公交。

ex.en: Liberty to speak still has a limit: no one may threaten a classmate.
ex.zh: 说话的自由仍有界限：谁也不能威胁同学。

tip: freedom 已在本库，更常用。liberty 更正式。

senses.en: to rest on a chair or the ground

ex.en: Please sit near the window if you need light.
ex.zh: 如果你需要光线，请坐在靠窗的地方。

ex.en: Students who sit in the same seat all term may never meet the classmates behind them.
ex.zh: 整个学期都坐同一座位的学生，可能始终认识不到身后的同学。

tip: sit 的过去式和过去分词都是 sat。坐下常用 sit down。

senses.en: a feeling of pleasure in what you or others have done

ex.en: She spoke with pride about the class garden.
ex.zh: 她自豪地谈起班级的园子。

ex.en: Pride in a score should still name who watered the garden.
ex.zh: 为分数自豪时，仍然应当说出是谁给园子浇的水。

tip: 形容词 proud 已在本库。take pride in doing。

senses.en: to go from one side to the other
a mark or a place where things meet
angry

ex.en: Cross the road at the lights.
ex.zh: 在红绿灯处过马路。

ex.en: Children cross a busy road more safely when the light gives them enough time.
ex.zh: 当信号灯给足时间时，孩子过繁忙的马路会更安全。

tip: cross 是动词；across 是介词。

senses.en: a soft hat, or a cover

ex.en: He left his cap on the chair.
ex.zh: 他把帽子落在椅子上了。

ex.en: A bottle cap that is loose in the lab is a reason to stop.
ex.zh: 实验室里松了的瓶盖是停下来的理由。

tip: cap 多指无檐或只有前面有檐的帽子。hat 通常更有边，本批另有词条。

senses.en: a sudden serious event causing harm
Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.

ex.en: An earthquake is a natural disaster.
ex.zh: 地震是一种自然灾害。

ex.en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
ex.zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。

tip: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

senses.en: a period in a process, or a platform for performers

ex.en: We are at the first stage of the project.
ex.zh: 我们处在项目的第一阶段。

ex.en: The stage of a plan that nobody checks is often the one that fails in the rain.
ex.zh: 计划中没人检查的那个阶段，往往是在雨里失败的阶段。

tip: stage 作动词是“上演”。

senses.en: a place to sit
to give someone a place to sit, or to have room for

ex.en: Is this seat free?
ex.zh: 这个座位有人吗？

ex.en: A reserved seat on the bus matters for a student who cannot stand the whole way.
ex.zh: 公交上的预留座位，对不能全程站着的学生很重要。

tip: seat 作动词是“使就座”，如 seat 30 people。

senses.en: towards the front

ex.en: Please step forward when your name is called.
ex.zh: 叫到你的名字时请向前走。

ex.en: Looking forward without asking residents can put a new road through the only playground.
ex.zh: 不询问居民就向前规划，可能会让新路穿过唯一的操场。

tip: look forward to 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: a small container for drinks, or a prize

ex.en: There is a cup of tea on the desk.
ex.zh: 桌上有一杯茶。

ex.en: Winning a cup brings a town one happy evening, not a clinic or a bus.
ex.zh: 赢得奖杯给城镇带来一个快乐的晚上，而不是诊所或公交。

tip: a cup of 后接不可数名词。

senses.en: a promise, or the time you give to something

ex.en: The club needs a commitment to lock the door.
ex.zh: 社团需要有人承诺锁门。

ex.en: A commitment to the late bus should be written, not only spoken.
ex.zh: 对晚班车的承诺应当写下来，而不只是说一说。

tip: commitment 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: a moving picture, or thin material for cameras
to record moving pictures

ex.en: We watched a short film about the town.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于这个城镇的短片。

ex.en: A film about a flood can move people, but it does not repair the broken drain.
ex.zh: 一部关于洪水的电影可以打动人，但修不好破损的排水管。

tip: 英式常用 film，美式常用 movie。

senses.en: a dirty or untidy state

ex.en: The lab was a mess after the experiment.
ex.zh: 实验之后实验室一片凌乱。

ex.en: A mess in the hallway is a safety problem if bags block the door.
ex.zh: 如果包堵住了门，走廊里的凌乱就是安全问题。

tip: mess 可数。make a mess of 表示把……搞糟。

senses.en: a standard, height, or rank

ex.en: Her reading level has improved this term.
ex.zh: 她的阅读水平这学期提高了。

ex.en: Noise levels beside a main road can be high enough to disturb an open classroom window.
ex.zh: 主干道旁的噪音水平可以高到打扰开着窗的教室。

col: at a high level｜在高水平
tip: level 作形容词是“平坦的”。

senses.en: later, after an event

ex.en: We cleaned the lab afterwards.
ex.zh: 后来我们打扫了实验室。

ex.en: Afterwards the notice was corrected, but the class had already left.
ex.zh: 后来通知改了，班级却已经走了。

tip: afterwards 是副词。美式也作 afterward。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: the United States, or the American continents

ex.en: She hopes to visit America after university.
ex.zh: 她希望大学毕业后去美国看看。

ex.en: News from America reaches a classroom in minutes, but students still need to ask who wrote it.
ex.zh: 来自美国的新闻几分钟就能进课堂，但学生仍要问是谁写的。

tip: 国家名 America 前通常不加 the；the United States 要加 the。

senses.en: a smaller road off a main one

ex.en: We took a side road to avoid the traffic.
ex.zh: 我们走了一条支路以避开车流。

ex.en: A side road without a pavement still forces children into the same space as cars.
ex.zh: 没有人行道的支路，仍然把孩子推进和汽车相同的空间。

tip: side road 是主路旁边的小路，不要和 roadside（路边）混用。

senses.en: with nothing inside
to remove everything from something

ex.en: The bottle was empty.
ex.zh: 瓶子是空的。

ex.en: An empty seat on the late bus is useless if the stop has no light.
ex.zh: 如果车站没有灯，晚班车上的空座也没用。

tip: empty 作动词是倒空。

senses.en: to connect in the mind, or to spend time with
a partner or colleague

ex.en: Students associate the bell with the end of class.
ex.zh: 学生把铃声和下课联系在一起。

ex.en: Do not associate one late bus with every driver.
ex.zh: 不要把一趟晚班车和每一位司机联系在一起。

col: associate A with B｜把 A 与 B 联系起来
tip: association 已在本库。associate 作名词是同事，重音常在后。

senses.en: in addition, or different

ex.en: Would anyone else like to speak?
ex.zh: 还有别人想发言吗？

ex.en: If the bus is full, students have little else to do but wait in the rain.
ex.zh: 如果公交满了，学生几乎只能在雨里等。

tip: else 放在疑问词或不定代词后面：what else、someone else。

senses.en: to get money or respect by work

ex.en: She earns her bus fare at the weekend.
ex.zh: 她周末挣公交费。

ex.en: A city earns trust when the flood plan is practised, not only printed.
ex.zh: 当防汛方案被演练而不只是被印刷时，城市才赢得信任。

tip: earn 后接钱、生活或尊重。

senses.en: an unusual and exciting experience

ex.en: The trip was an adventure, and everyone came back.
ex.zh: 这次出行是一次奇遇，而且每个人都回来了。

ex.en: An adventure on the river still needs life jackets.
ex.zh: 河上的冒险仍然需要救生衣。

tip: adventure 可数。

senses.en: a strip worn around the waist, or a region

ex.en: The belt on the bag is loose.
ex.zh: 包上的带子松了。

ex.en: A green belt around the town keeps a path for walking.
ex.zh: 城镇周围的绿化带留出一条步行的路。

tip: seat belt 是安全带。

senses.en: a hard building material
definite and real, not only an idea

ex.en: The path is concrete, not soil.
ex.zh: 这条路是混凝土的，不是土的。

ex.en: A concrete plan names who locks the door.
ex.zh: 一个具体的计划会写明谁锁门。

tip: concrete 作形容词是具体的，和抽象相对。

senses.en: the highest part or rank
highest in position or degree

ex.en: My name is at the top of the list.
ex.zh: 我的名字在名单最上面。

ex.en: Standing at the top of a test list does not show whether a student can work with other people.
ex.zh: 站在成绩榜顶端，并不能说明一个学生能否与他人合作。

tip: top 作形容词表示“顶级的”：top speed。

senses.en: a formal meeting of questions
to ask someone questions in a formal meeting

ex.en: She has an interview at the library on Friday.
ex.zh: 她周五在图书馆有一场面试。

ex.en: An interview that only rewards confidence can miss a quiet student who knows the work.
ex.zh: 只奖励自信的面试，可能错过一个懂业务但安静的学生。

tip: interview 可作名词或动词。采访和面试是同一个词。

senses.en: almost the same

ex.en: The two maps are similar, but not the same.
ex.zh: 两张地图相似，但并不相同。

ex.en: Similar test scores can hide very different chances to study at home.
ex.zh: 相似的考分可能掩盖在家学习机会的巨大差别。

tip: similar to 后接比较对象，不用 with。

senses.en: all of something

ex.en: I spent the whole morning in the lab.
ex.zh: 我整个上午都在实验室。

ex.en: Protecting a whole river means caring for farms and factories, not only the city section.
ex.zh: 保护整条河意味着要管农场和工厂，而不只是城区那一段。

tip: whole 前面通常有 the 或物主代词：the whole day。

senses.en: an idea or the act of thinking
past form of think

ex.en: That is a thoughtful question.
ex.zh: 那是一个有想法的问题。

ex.en: A single thoughtless comment online can follow a student longer than the mistake that caused it.
ex.zh: 网上一句欠考虑的话，可能比引发它的那个错误跟随学生更久。

tip: thought 也是 think 的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: to respect or look up to someone
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire her courage in difficult times.
ex.zh: 我钦佩她在困难时期的勇气。

ex.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
ex.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: a state or requirement
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: The road is in poor condition.
ex.zh: 这条路状况很差。

ex.en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
ex.zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。

tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

senses.en: a container for liquids, usually glass or plastic

ex.en: Please return the bottle to the bin.
ex.zh: 请把瓶子放回桶里。

ex.en: A labelled bottle in the lab is safer than a faster experiment.
ex.zh: 实验室里贴了标签的瓶子，比做得更快的实验更安全。

tip: bottle 可数。作动词是把……装瓶。

senses.en: not joined, or different
to divide or keep apart

ex.en: Keep the broken glass in a separate box.
ex.zh: 把碎玻璃放在单独的盒子里。

ex.en: Separate queues for the bus stop a crowd from pushing the smallest students aside.
ex.zh: 分开排队能避免人群把最小的学生挤到一边。

tip: 形容词常读 /ˈsepərət/，动词“分开”常读 /ˈsepəreɪt/。

senses.en: not mixed with anything else

ex.en: The lab uses pure water.
ex.zh: 实验室用纯净水。

ex.en: Pure luck does not explain a result that the same class can repeat.
ex.zh: 同一个班能重复的结果，不能只用纯运气解释。

tip: purely 表示完全地、仅仅。pure 不要和 poor 混淆。

senses.en: how heavy something is

ex.en: The bag is light in weight.
ex.zh: 这个包重量很轻。

ex.en: The weight of a full schoolbag is a daily load, especially for younger children on a long walk.
ex.zh: 装满的书包的重量是每天的负担，尤其对走远路的年幼孩子。

tip: weight 是名词；weigh 是动词“称重”。

senses.en: to hit, to attack suddenly, or to stop work in protest

ex.en: The bell will strike at eight.
ex.zh: 钟将在八点敲响。

ex.en: When bus drivers strike, the school needs a written way for students to get home.
ex.zh: 公交司机罢工时，学校需要一份书面办法让学生回家。

tip: strike 的过去式和过去分词一般是 struck。罢工用 go on strike。本条不写任何伤害方法。

senses.en: to take something that is not yours

ex.en: He did not steal the book; it was a loan.
ex.zh: 他没有偷书，那是借的。

ex.en: A school should not call a hungry child a thief for taking bread.
ex.zh: 学校不应当因为一个饥饿的孩子拿了面包就把他叫做小偷。

tip: steal 的过去式是 stole，过去分词是 stolen。本条不写偷窃方法。

senses.en: to move around, or to become
a chance to do something, or a change of direction

ex.en: Turn left at the bookshop.
ex.zh: 在书店处向左转。

ex.en: Parks can turn a hot street into a place where people are willing to walk.
ex.zh: 公园能把一条炎热的街道变成人们愿意步行的地方。

tip: turn 加形容词表示变化：turn green。开灯用 turn on，不是 open the light。
